verdict.rationale: The Conta Simples homepage claims users can see spend and return by channel and receive AI-generated alerts and strategic insights. That is a first-party capability for this story, but it rests on a single marketing line with no further detail. missing for 10: documentation of what AI insights and suggestions are generated and from which data, how they surface in the product, any suggestion or recommendation workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
